name: Play as Pokemon
summary: Turn into any Pokémon in Pokopia. Use their abilities: flying Pokémon can fly, and Grow, Burn, Water and Generate Pokémon can use their ability. Works in co-op / Link Play: every player needs the mod installed.
controls: Turn into the chosen Pokémon; press again to turn back
Pick the previous / next Pokémon (A to Z)
Use the Pokémon's ability (Grow, Burn, Water, Generate) on what is in front of you
Take off; tap to rise a little, hold to rise faster
Descend the same way, keep holding on the ground to land
